findings.title: Release note compares one run's cost with the whole session's (inference: makes the gap look bigger than the source says)
findings.evidence: CHANGELOG.md 4.0.1 'Fixed' item: 'the run record held $0.63 against the $7 budget while the session spent $32.14'. docs/v4/sumit-run.md:122 says $0.63 is for run 1 only (runs 2 and 3 showed nothing), and sumit-run.md:45-46 puts the whole session at $32.14 across all three runs and run 1 at about $19 (estimate). Every number is sourced and literally true. Only the comparison mixes one run with three.
findings.reproduce: sed -n 45,46p docs/v4/sumit-run.md; sed -n 122,123p docs/v4/sumit-run.md; grep -n '0.63' CHANGELOG.md
findings.recommendation: Write 'the run records held $0.63 for run 1 and nothing for runs 2 and 3, while the session spent $32.14'. Alternatively, compare $0.63 with run 1's ≈$19 estimate.
